message: Tool input reaches a dangerous call: a program is started with arguments taken from tool input.
fix: Call validatePackageName() for package/bundle ids in MobileDevice too, reject values starting with '-', and put '--' before positional values if mobilecli supports it.
reason: execFileSync with an argument array means no shell injection, but for simulator devices (MobileDevice) packageName, bundle_id, path, url and text from tool arguments are passed to mobilecli as positional values with no `--` and no validation (unlike the Android path, which uses validatePackageName), so a value starting with `-` is parsed as a mobilecli flag. Impact depends on mobilecli's own flags, which are not in this repo.

message: Tool input reaches a dangerous call: a program is started with arguments taken from tool input.
reason: executeCommandBuffer is only called with a fixed argument list plus deviceId, and deviceId must exactly match a device returned by the device listing before a robot is created; execFileSync uses no shell.

message: Tool input reaches a dangerous call: a file is written / deleted / moved at a path taken from tool input.
fix: None needed (optionally avoid logging full tool arguments).
reason: The log path comes from the operator's LOG_FILE environment variable, not from tool input; only the log message contains tool arguments.

title: mobile_save_screenshot writes to any path given in saveTo
reason: saveTo from the tool arguments is written with no checks, so a prompt injection (e.g. text shown on the device screen) can make the agent overwrite any file the user can write, such as ~/.bashrc, ~/.ssh/authorized_keys or project files, with PNG data (file destruction; content is not attacker-chosen).
fix: Write only inside a dedicated screenshots directory: take a bare file name, require .png, resolve with realpath and check path.relative(baseDir, p) does not start with '..'; refuse to overwrite existing files.

title: mobile_start_screen_recording writes the recording to any output path
reason: output from the tool arguments is handed to mobilecli as the output file without any check, so the same arbitrary-file-overwrite applies with MP4 data.
fix: Apply the same base-directory containment and .mp4 extension check as for screenshots, or always use a server-generated temp path.

title: SSE mode listens on all interfaces with no authentication and lets any client take over the session
reason: With --port, express listens on every interface (no host given) with no auth, Origin or Host check, and each GET /mcp replaces the current transport; anyone on the network can drive the connected phones (tap, type, install/uninstall apps, open URLs) and use the file-write tools above.
fix: Bind to 127.0.0.1 by default, require a bearer token, validate Origin/Host headers, and keep one transport per authenticated session.

title: On-screen text from the device is returned to the model unmarked
reason: Text of SMS, emails, web pages and notifications on the device goes straight into the model context, and the same agent can type, open URLs and save files with no approval step, so text on screen can steer it (untrusted input + private data on the phone + a way out).
fix: Label returned screen text as untrusted data, and have clients require approval for destructiveHint tools (type, open_url, install/uninstall, save_screenshot).

title: Telemetry to PostHog is always on with no opt-out
reason: Every launch and tool call sends tool name, duration, platform, client name and a hostname-derived id to a third party with no environment switch to disable it; the embedded phc_ key is a public ingest key, not a secret.
fix: Add an opt-out (e.g. MOBILEMCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY / DO_NOT_TRACK) and document it.
